story:
The tradklan have two sets of trunks in Faraheim. Cronk's are in the north-west, and every traveller in Hagall knows them. The southern trunks are further down the western woods, smaller and quieter, and their chief is Bokko, who is larger than Cronk and older, and who has never held the right of fire.

He believes he should have. On the night the chiefs before Cronk burned the clan's houses, the clan was left without a chief and without trunks, and by the clan's oldest law the right of fire passes to one of the old chief's sisters' children, chosen out of the ashes. There were two of age that night. One was Cronk. The other was Bokko. The southern trunks say it was settled by which of them was dragged out of the ashes first, and that Trude dragged her brother out and left Bokko to crawl out by himself, and that the clan was too frightened that night to argue with a woman carrying a child under each arm.

Bokko took the half of the clan that agreed with him and went south. He built new trunks there without fire, which a tree-clan can do if it is willing to eat cold and sleep cold, and his people have done both for longer than Cronk has held the fire. They think it has made them hard. The northern trunks think it has made them miserable. Bokko's medicine men keep a single coal in a clay pot, unlit, against the day they say the clan will need a chief who has never burned anything.

He is a great slow heavy tradklan, and he fights as his people live, without fire and without hurry, and his trunks come round him when he is struck as Cronk's come round Cronk. The dwarves of Hagall say the two halves of the tree-clan have never come to blows, because a clan that fights itself in a wood with only one fire between them is a clan that burns.
legend: Bokko is the chief of the southern tradklan trunks in west Faraheim, level 60 and big, standing among tribesmen, medicine men and darters (52-57). He's not part of Cronk's pack, so no fire and no Cronk, but he's Tradklan Tribe, so hitting him can bring the nearby tradklan along (bring-a-friend), and there are a lot of them standing close: six tribesmen, five medicine men and seven darters within about 600. Pull him out with range and work the tradklan from the edges (the medicine men have no spells in this world, despite the name), and keep the fight away from the middle of the trunks. No special abilities on Bokko himself, not CC-immune, no quest.

loremasterTopic.text: Chief of the southern tradklan trunks, larger and older than [Cronk], who says the right of fire was his on the night the houses burned until [Trude] chose. His people live cold. See [tree-clan].

bookPage: From the trap-lines of Solvi of Hagall: the southern trunks are the coldest place I know of in the western woods, and I have slept in snow. No smoke. No hearth. The tradklan there eat their meat raw and their children sleep in heaps for the warmth. I saw the clay pot once, carried by a medicine man on a cord round his neck, and asked through the kobold what was in it. The medicine man opened it for me. It was a black coal, cold as a stone. He said: the next chief. Then he closed it again.
